identity_check: Confirmed as IndustrialMind.ai (industrialmind.ai), the manufacturing-AI start-up founded by former Tesla Gigafactory manufacturing-AI leaders (co-founders Steven Gao, CEO, and Justin Li). The company's site, its own pre-seed press release, The AI Insider's republication of the Business Wire release and Antler's 2025 Disrupt portfolio announcement all link to or name industrialmind.ai and describe the same product (an 'AI manufacturing engineer' for drawings, production monitoring and root-cause analysis) and the same investors and customers (Antler, TSVC, Plug and Play; Siemens, tesa, Andritz). The site is a client-rendered app: page text was read from the HTML head (meta description, FAQ structured data) and the site's own published JavaScript bundle that renders each listed URL. It is not shown as an Antler India company: no page read ties it to Antler India's Embark programme or to Indian founders; Antler presents it in its Singapore-run 2025 Disrupt portfolio, and its listed offices are Mountain View (US), Singapore and Munich (careers). Category set to 'direct': its agents do drawing review, BOM generation from drawings, drawing-to-process and drawing-to-quote (RFQ), production monitoring for process stability, predictive maintenance and root-cause analysis, which is most of Utopian Autonomy's plant-function scope. The difference is the channel and buyer: it sells to engineering and quality teams at large manufacturers and equipment makers (Siemens, tesa, ANDRITZ) with a forward-deployed model; no WhatsApp or shop-floor messaging channel and no procurement-negotiation agent were seen.

company.name: IndustrialMind.ai
company.description: Ex-Tesla-founded start-up building an 'AI manufacturing engineer': agents that turn engineering drawings into BOMs, process plans and quotes, monitor production and run root-cause analysis.

layer_detail: Spans process planning and plant ops. Process planning: drawing review against internal standards, drawing-to-process and drawing-to-quote agents, BOM and routing generation from drawings, should-cost quotes (deployed at ANDRITZ for hydraulic equipment parts). Plant ops: real-time production monitoring and anomaly prediction for process stability, SPC, predictive maintenance and multi-agent root-cause analysis with auto-generated reports. Also an 'IM foundation model' and a free drawing-parser tool. Sells to manufacturers, equipment makers and integrators (sheet metal, casting, battery, electrical panels) through a forward-deployed model; no WhatsApp channel seen.
product_summary: An AI 'manufacturing engineer': agents that read engineering drawings to draft BOMs, routings, process plans and should-cost quotes, review drawings against internal standards, monitor production in real time to flag anomalies, and run multi-agent root-cause analysis with auto-generated reports, delivered by forward-deployed engineers.
